findings.motion: Added as a petitioner (co-signer) of H.720, An Act establishing identification at the voting polls
findings.note: Vaughn is one of eight legislators named on the petition for H.720, added 2/14/2023. The bill has the state secretary issue a free photo ID card for voting only, and requires a person voting in a federal, state, local or primary election to show a valid photo ID, MassHealth card or Medicare card to an election officer before voting. The bill went to the Election Laws committee and on 2024-07-15 accompanied a study order (H4733).
subjects: free state-issued voter photo ID card
